rationale: This additive Experience-only presentation repair makes the Runtime health ribbon respond to the actual workspace container after a docked assistant reduces the available width, prohibits within-word breaks in its human-readable labels and values, and exposes the existing browser-local Dark, Light, and System preference in the persistent application header. It reuses the canonical appearance state and storage adapter; it creates no parallel state, Runtime claim, capability, Authority path, Evidence, Mission, or operational mutation.
